solution: The feasible region is above/on \(3x+8y=24\) and below/on \(4x+5y=20\) and \(5x+3y=15\). Checking the origin: \(3(0)+8(0)=0\geq24\) is false, so the origin lies on the \(\leq\) side and the region on the other: \(3x+8y\geq24\). The origin satisfies \(4x+5y\leq20\) and \(5x+3y\leq15\), and the region lies on the origin's side of both lines. That is option D. Matches option D.
note: said that evaluating every constraint at the origin confirms D; the origin fails 3x+8y >= 24. Key D unchanged.
